title: SSV Silver Gull — Ship Combat
description: Ship-combat systems for the SSV Silver Gull campaign. Full-screen Ship Overview (press S) with a crew-centric multiplayer turn/action tracker and per-station action consoles for all 15 stations. Shields/Comms is fully built (Allocate Shields, Jam/Hail rolls, violet-arc Micro-Adjust); the Captain's Grant Actions gives a crew a purple-star extra action. The Pilot drives the ship inline from the turn bar (pick a maneuver → Movement Points → move/rotate the ship token; action circle drains full→half→empty, bonus adds +1), and a GM Proficiency editor adds a crew's proficiency bonus to named station rolls. A GM-only ⚙ GM Actions panel changes shields directly (no action cost) and announces to chat. Ship Inventory is a game-style grid (item pictures, search, ship/you tabs, hover detail popup) linked to the dnd5e ship actor: move items crew↔ship, FUEL/POWER gauges, per-item fuel/power role+amount, convert fuel→power (1→5 or 10→50), and GMs can add/edit/delete any item (searchable browser over all world items + item compendiums, or drag-drop).
